zero.interpretation: Failure has no ongoing utility; negative control.

stationary_collapse.interpretation: Low, tilted, unsupported failure with no excessive motion; posture and height penalty bound.

observed_collapse.interpretation: Constant task utility anchored to pooled preterminal deep/contact-collapse median, excluding shaping and fall component.

physical_lower_bound.interpretation: Existing unshaped nonterminal lower bound; worst physical quality, not an extra tuned coefficient.

sustained_controlled_standing.interpretation: Ideal fully supported neutral standing reused from Step 129; not a learned controller trajectory.

prompt_recovery.interpretation: Step 129 shared-prefix artificial 60-tick recovery ramp followed by ideal neutral standing.
prompt_recovery.feasibility: Prescribed measurements; native classification; no proven joint/force/action feasibility.

delayed_recovery.interpretation: Step 129 shared-prefix 720-tick unstable hold, artificial recovery ramp, then ideal standing.
delayed_recovery.feasibility: Prescribed measurements; native classification; no proven joint/force/action feasibility.

constant_unbalanced_posture.interpretation: Step 129 shared-prefix 35-degree unsupported-margin posture held until truncation.
constant_unbalanced_posture.feasibility: Prescribed measurements; native classification; no proven joint/force/action feasibility.

controlled_crouch.interpretation: Supported upright crouch at 62% neutral height after a two-second measurement ramp; classifier state is reported separately.
controlled_crouch.feasibility: Classifier and Reward V2 are real; prescribed body measurements do not prove joint, contact-force, or action feasibility.

oscillate_near_balanced_boundary.interpretation: Repeated supported 14-to-26-degree lean cycles around the classifier stay/entry boundary; ramps are measurement interpolation, not an action replay.
oscillate_near_balanced_boundary.feasibility: Classifier and Reward V2 are real; prescribed body measurements do not prove joint, contact-force, or action feasibility.

constant_near_balanced_posture.interpretation: Supported, motionless 19-degree posture above the strict BALANCED entry threshold but within its retention-angle band.
constant_near_balanced_posture.feasibility: Classifier and Reward V2 are real; prescribed body measurements do not prove joint, contact-force, or action feasibility.

constant_near_fall_stall.interpretation: Unsupported 59-degree posture below the classifier collapse-angle condition, reached over three seconds and held to truncation.
constant_near_fall_stall.feasibility: Classifier and Reward V2 are real; prescribed body measurements do not prove joint, contact-force, or action feasibility.

oscillate_near_fallen_boundary.interpretation: Unsupported low posture oscillating 59-to-61 degrees; brief collapse-threshold crossings test the classifier persistence rule.
oscillate_near_fallen_boundary.feasibility: Classifier and Reward V2 are real; prescribed body measurements do not prove joint, contact-force, or action feasibility.

slow_collapse_below_terminal_angle.interpretation: Two-second supported lean/height ramp to 55 degrees and 40% height, then held below the 60-degree deep-collapse condition.
slow_collapse_below_terminal_angle.feasibility: Classifier and Reward V2 are real; prescribed body measurements do not prove joint, contact-force, or action feasibility.

confirmed_collapse.interpretation: Common standing prefix followed by measured collapse; the native classifier determines FALLEN and physical termination.
confirmed_collapse.feasibility: Classifier and Reward V2 are real; prescribed body measurements do not prove joint, contact-force, or action feasibility.
